## Loading dataset {.tabset}

### load dataset
```{r load_dataset}

TICAtlas <- LoadSeuratRds("data/TICAtlas.rds")

TICAtlas # 92,256 features across 317,111 cells (RNA assay)

head(TICAtlas@meta.data) 

# set object defaults 
DefaultAssay(TICAtlas) <- "RNA"
Idents(TICAtlas) <- TICAtlas@meta.data$subtype

# filter out OC subtype 
y <- TICAtlas@meta.data$subtype
table(y)/1000
# OC has lowest number of cells and therefore downstream analysis is highly variable just due to low number 
# remove OC from dataset

# remove OC subtype
Idents(TICAtlas) <- TICAtlas@meta.data$subtype
TICAtlas <- subset(TICAtlas, idents = "OC", invert = T)
y <- TICAtlas@meta.data$subtype
table(y)/1000


```

### Prepare dataset / read and filter for CD4 / or load dataset

```{r read_dataset_pancancer}

if(long.compute){
  head(TICAtlas@meta.data)
  
  # subset for CD4 subsets only
  Idents(TICAtlas) <- TICAtlas@meta.data$cell_type
  unique(Idents(TICAtlas))
  
  
  CD4.TICAtlas <- subset(TICAtlas, idents = c("Recently activated CD4 T cells", 
                                              "Naive-memory CD4 T cells", 
                                              "Transitional memory CD4 T cells",
                                              "Th17 cells", 
                                              "Naive T cells", 
                                              "Regulatory T cells", 
                                              "T helper cells", 
                                              "Proliferative T cells"))
  
  library(harmony)
  # Normalise and harmonize dataset and calculate umap projection
  CD4.TICAtlas <- 
    CD4.TICAtlas %>%
    NormalizeData() %>%
    FindVariableFeatures() %>%
    ScaleData() %>%
    RunPCA() %>%
    harmony::RunHarmony(reduction.use = "pca",
                        group.by.vars = c("patient", "subtype"), 
                        plot_convergence = TRUE, 
                        verbose = TRUE) %>%
    RunUMAP(reduction = "harmony", 
            dims = 1:20) %>%
    FindNeighbors(reduction = "harmony",
                  dims = 1:20) %>%
    FindClusters(resolution = 0.5)
  
  
  # save filtered dataset
  SaveH5Seurat(CD4.TICAtlas, 
               "data/CD4_TICAtlas.h5Seurat",
               overwrite = TRUE)
  
  
}else{
  
  #pancancer.cd8 <- LoadH5Seurat("data/external_datasets/pancancer_cd8_normed.h5Seurat")
  
}

```

### CD226 expression
```{r CD226_expression}


output.dir <- "results/CD226/"
if(!dir.exists(output.dir)){
  dir.create(output.dir, 
             recursive = T)}


DefaultAssay(TICAtlas) <- "RNA"


# sorted vln plot of cytotoxicity 
VlnPlot_scCustom(CD4.TICAtlas, 
                 feature = "CD226", 
                 sort = TRUE,
                 group.by = "cell_type",
                 pt.size = 0.1) + NoLegend()

dev.copy(pdf, paste0(output.dir, "TICAtlas_CD4s_vln_plot_CD226.pdf"))
dev.off()

# subset for cd226 expression only 

# Subset cells with CD226 expression greater than 0
seurat_subset <- subset(CD4.TICAtlas, subset = CD226 > 0)

VlnPlot_scCustom(seurat_subset, 
                 feature = "CD226", 
                 sort = TRUE,
                 group.by = "cell_type",
                 pt.size = 0) + NoLegend()

dev.copy(pdf, paste0(output.dir, "TICAtlas_CD4s_vln_plot_CD226_CD226_expressing.pdf"))
dev.off()




# density plot of cytotoxicity singature 

scCustomize::Plot_Density_Custom(CD4.TICAtlas, 
                                 features = "CD226", 
                                 custom_palette = batlow.pal)

ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "TICAtlas_CD4s_density_plot_CD226.tiff"), width = 12, height = 12, units = "in", device = "tiff", dpi = 320)

dev.copy(pdf, paste0(output.dir, "TICAtlas_CD4s_density_plot_CD226.pdf"))
dev.off()


table(CD4.TICAtlas@meta.data$subtype, CD4.TICAtlas@meta.data$cell_type)




if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("remotes")
}
remotes::install_github("huayc09/SeuratExtend")

library(SeuratExtend)
VlnPlot2(seurat_subset, 
                 feature = "CD226", 
                 sort = TRUE,
                 group.by = "cell_type",
         stat.method = "wilcox.test", 
         hide.ns = TRUE)
dev.copy(pdf, paste0(output.dir, "TICAtlas_CD4s_vln_with_stats_cd226_only.pdf"))
dev.off()

ClusterDistrBar(origin = seurat_subset@meta.data$subtype, 
                cluster = seurat_subset@meta.data$cell_type, 
                rev = TRUE,
                normalize = T)

dev.copy(pdf, paste0(output.dir, "TICAtlas_CD4s_cluster_distribution_CD226_expressing_cells_normed.pdf"))
dev.off()
```
